author: Ahimanikya Satapathy

sources.title: Lipi Das · Traditional Rice Foods: The Rich Heritage of India (2015)
sources.note: Printed pages 23, 26, 29 (PDF 34, 37, 40); preface. Institutional compilation using primary and secondary material.

sources.title: Priyadarshini Chatterjee · In Odisha, ‘podo pitha’ is a sentiment (2023)
sources.note: 16 June 2023; named accounts by Sujata Dehury and Sweta Biswal. Regional descriptions are attributed, not a prevalence survey.

evidence_limits: No recipe testing, household interview, human Odia review or current serving confirmation.
No original historical source establishes an inventor, first date or exclusive place of origin.
Tourism endpoint returned 404 during readiness review; no fresh Tourism claim used.
Mausi Maa recipe and literary-origin claims omitted because inspected reporting was second-hand and original historical editions were not read.
reading_gain: Explains differences in mixtures, leaves and cooking arrangements; compares named regional accounts without turning them into universal recipes.
